newsitem.title: USA: Clinton seen acting on tobacco deal in September.
newsitem.headline: Clinton seen acting on tobacco deal in September.

text.p: President Clinton is not expected to make a decision on whether to approve the $368.5 billion tobacco settlement until he returns from his vacation in early September, the White House said Monday.

"If the review is complete before he leaves on his vacation, he may get it," White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters. "I don't anticipate him actually acting on the proposed recommendations by his review group until he returns in September."
Clinton is expected to leave for vacation on the resort island of Martha's Vineyard off the coast of Massachusetts in the middle of this month and return about September 7.
